title: Controller identity pinning and session record intake
description: Controller identity pinning and session record intake.
acceptance: The controller identity is pinned out of band; no online enrollment handshake exists
Records are accepted only from that identity, and are immutable per (session_handle, epoch)
declared_roles are unique, non-empty UTF-8 strings of at most 256 bytes
findings: Replaces enrollment with the router. Router and factory no longer exist in the spec.
